source.title: Inductance Calculation Example
source.author: David Meeker
source.native_reference_policy: Reference file is a verification oracle only. Do not use its geometry as input to a claimed paper-to-model generation test.

published_references.limitation: Lumped approximation neglects fringing/leakage; not the FEMM acceptance target.

blocker: The companion file verifies that each winding face shares iron-window boundaries. Our general planar GeometryPlan requires separated closed contours and rejects these touching/shared interfaces. An exact recreation requires conformal shared-edge topology support. Adding artificial clearance or changing the windows would change the source case.
result: No mesh, solve or target pass is claimed. Lubin2012 is the active journal reproduction benchmark.
